claims: Chipotle is offering a Buy-One-Get-One (BOGO) free entrée for customers who wear a hockey jersey to participating locations in the U.S. and Canada on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The deal is valid in-restaurant only after 3 p.m. local time.
The deal is to celebrate the start of the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs.
Chipotle's 4/20 deal requires wearing a hockey jersey to the restaurant.
Chipotle's 4/20 deal is available after 3:00 p.m. local time on Monday, April 20, 2026.
Chipotle's 4/20 deal is valid in-restaurant only at participating locations.
Chipotle's 4/20 deal is not valid for online, mobile, or delivery orders.
Chipotle has offered the 4/20 Chipotle Deal for the sixth consecutive year, per USA TODAY
